root_cause.text: The function `__scmi_event_handler_get_ops` in the ARM SCMI notify subsystem could return NULL when no event handler was found or created, but after commit b5daf93b809d1, its callers expected an ERR_PTR on failure, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when they dereferenced the returned value.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the return from `return hndl;` to `return hndl ?: ERR_PTR(-ENODEV);` and the commit message states "the current helper can still return a NULL when no handler could be found or created" while "call chains ... expect an ERR_PTR to be returned on failure".
